chunks: They both said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is your view of the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'Indeed the charities are only for the poor and the needy and those appointed over them and those whose hearts are to be reconciled and for (freeing) the slaves and the debtors and in the way of God and the wayfarer — an obligation from God.' Should all of these be given (the charity) even if one does not recognize (the Imam's authority)? He said: 'The Imam gives to all of them altogether, because they acknowledge obedience to him.'

He (the narrator) said: I said: 'But if they do not recognize?' He said: 'O Zurara, if he were to give only to those who recognize, excluding those who do not recognize, there would be no place for it (the obligation). Rather, he gives to those who do not recognize so that they may incline toward the Religion and become steadfast upon it. But as for today, you and your companions must not give it except to the one who recognizes. So whoever among these Muslims you find who recognizes, give to him ahead of others.'

Then he said: 'The share of those whose hearts incline and the share of the slaves is general, and the rest is specific.' He said: I said: 'What if they (the deserving recipients) cannot be found?' He said: 'It cannot be that an obligation which God Mighty and Majestic has obligated has no deserving recipient for it.'

He said: I said: 'What if the charities are insufficient for them?' He said: 'Indeed God has prescribed for the poor, in the wealth of the rich, what suffices them; and had He known that it would not suffice them, He would have increased it for them. It (poverty) did not reach them from the direction of the obligation of God, but they were afflicted because of those who withheld their rights — not from what God had prescribed for them. And had people paid their rights, they (the poor) would all be living a good life.'

key_terms.ابن السبيل: Wayfarer — a traveler who is stranded without resources
key_terms.الرقاب: Slaves/captives — those to be freed using zakat funds
key_terms.الغارمين: The debtors — those burdened with debts they cannot repay
key_terms.المؤلفة قلوبهم: Those whose hearts are reconciled — one of the eight categories of zakat recipients
key_terms.فريضة: Obligation — a divinely imposed religious duty
key_terms.يعرف: Recognizes — specifically refers to recognition of the Imam's wilayah (authority)

ai.seo_question: To whom should zakat be given according to Imam al-Sadiq? What is the Shia ruling on zakat distribution?
ai.summary: Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim ask Imam al-Sadiq about the eight categories of zakat recipients mentioned in Quran 9:60, specifically whether those who do not acknowledge the Imam's authority (wilayah) should receive it. The Imam explains that in principle the Imam distributes to all categories since all acknowledge general obedience, but in the current era (of the Imam's lifetime, as distinct from the Imam's ideal authority), the believers should give only to those who recognize the Imam's authority. He then addresses the systemic cause of poverty, declaring that God has already prescribed sufficient funds for the poor in the wealth of the rich, and that the real problem is the wealthy withholding what is rightfully owed.
